title: Responses send isolation headers
summary: GET /health must include nosniff and DENY framing headers.
description: The smallest useful security check on an API: after the handler runs, the response must carry X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: DENY. Compare SuperTest, Playwright request, and pytest + httpx on the same contract.
architecture: This is not a JSON-body integration test. The SUT is the Express middleware that sets isolation headers on every response. Each variant issues GET /health and asserts those two header values. SuperTest stays in-process; Playwright and pytest talk to a real port.

variants.label: Playwright
variants.notes: Uses Playwright's APIRequest context only — no browser is launched.

variants.label: pytest + httpx
variants.notes: Spawns samples/js-api/scripts/serve-ephemeral.mjs so httpx talks to the same Express app.
